evals.prompt: Сохрани всё, я сейчас сожму контекст. Сегодня мы нашли запись о браке прапрадеда в метрике 1891 года (кадр 118, запись № 23, ещё не до конца прочитали фамилию невесты — то ли Гринберг, то ли Грюнберг), агент-чтец читает книгу рождений 1892–1894 на FamilySearch и сейчас стоит на капче, а второй агент скачивал опись с Commons и вроде закончил. Завтра хочу продолжить.
evals.expected_output: Records the marriage find in the findings log with the frame, entry number, a verbatim quotation and a note that the reading of the bride's surname is uncertain (both versions, "(?)"), without presenting it as verified. Updates the persons file and the hypothesis status. Enters the session's searches in the search log with coverage. In "Continue from here", following the template: the "waiting for the human" section — pass the captcha on FamilySearch in the reader agent's tab; a table of agents with their logs, status (captcha / finished) and resume point; a note that the second agent's report has not yet been accepted. The next step is concrete (finish reading the bride's surname on an enlarged frame 118; continue the 1892–1894 book from the stated frame). Rereads the file through the eyes of a new session and briefly tells the user the outcome.

evals.prompt: Привет, продолжи с того места, где мы остановились вчера.
evals.expected_output: Reads the "Continue from here" file (and, if needed, the latest entries of the findings log and the search log, and the current hypothesis) without starting a search straight away. Checks the background tasks: status, time of the last change of their logs; offers to accept finished reports by the rules (check against the frame, control record, coverage, access errors) and to relaunch dropped agents as new ones from the resume point. Asks whether what was waiting for the human has been done (captcha, VPN, decisions). Sets out the picture in 5–7 lines and proposes a first step, waiting for confirmation. If there is no such file, assembles the picture from the findings log and the search log and creates it from the template.

evals.prompt: Закругляемся на сегодня. Мы весь вечер искали семью Розенфельд в ревизии 1850 года по Житомирскому уезду, просмотрели дело целиком — 412 страниц — и ничего не нашли. Ещё проверили два сайта, один не открылся из-за VPN. Запиши, что надо, и скажи, что мне сделать до завтра.
evals.expected_output: Records the empty result in the search log with coverage: the file (archival reference), pages 1–412, spellings, reading method, whether the control record was found; explains what the zero means and draws no negative conclusion from it unless the conditions are met. Marks the site that did not open through the VPN as an unfinished search, not as a zero. In "Continue from here": waiting for the human — switch off the VPN for that site; the next step is concrete (what to check next at the "not found" fork: spellings, registration in another community, the second copy). Records a lesson if there is one. Briefly tells the user what to do before tomorrow.
